name: BeFunky
description_en:
BeFunky is a browser creative suite combining Photo Editor, Collage Maker and Graphic Designer. It handles individual photo adjustments, retouching, effects and layout work, while separate batch tools apply operations to collections. Its current Free, Plus and Pro plans distinguish basic bulk editing from credit-consuming AI batch workflows.

It fits creators preparing consistent product images, campaign assets or personal photo collections. Evaluate the actual crop/output and AI fidelity on representative images before processing a whole set. A premium editing subscription does not guarantee accurate restoration, unrestricted stock rights or unlimited AI generation.
description_zh:
BeFunky是结合Photo Editor、Collage Maker及Graphic Designer的浏览器创作套件，可做单图调整、修饰、效果及布局，另有批量工具处理图片集合。当前Free、Plus和Pro区分基础批量编辑与消耗点数的AI批量流程。

它适合准备统一商品图、活动素材或个人照片集的创作者。整批处理前应以代表图核对裁切、输出及AI保真。高级编辑订阅不保证修复准确、图库权利无约束或AI无限生成。

core_features.explanation_zh: Plus含基础批量，Pro增加AI批量/去背景并共享点数额度。

core_features.explanation_zh: Batch Crop支持比例、自动焦点及导出前逐图调整裁切框。

sections.title_en: Choose the editor that matches the deliverable
sections.title_zh: 按交付物选择编辑入口
sections.en:
The [homepage](https://www.befunky.com/) separates Photo Editor for improving/transforming an image, Collage Maker for combining images and Graphic Designer for templates or a blank design. AI tools include background removal, object erasing, enhancement, restoration, expansion and prompt-based edits; these are not all the same operation or necessarily included in Free. The price page is the entitlement reference for current Plus/Pro scope.

Editorial example: a shop needs consistent listing photos and one promotional collage. Prepare and check the photos in the editor/batch tool, then compose the collage/design from those approved images. Uniform processing does not ensure every subject is correctly framed or that an AI restoration preserves a real person or product feature.
sections.zh:
[首页](https://www.befunky.com/)区分：Photo Editor改善/转换单图，Collage Maker组合多图，Graphic Designer使用模板或空白设计。AI含去背景、对象移除、增强、修复、扩展和提示编辑，但这些不是同一操作，也不全都属于Free。当前Plus/Pro权益应以价格页为准。

编辑示例：商店需要统一商品图及一张宣传拼图，先在编辑器/批量工具准备和检查照片，再用获批图片拼图/设计。统一处理不保证每个主体都正确入框，也不保证AI修复保留真实人物或产品特征。

sections.title_en: Set a crop, inspect each frame and save the collection
sections.title_zh: 设定裁切、逐框检查并保存整组
sections.en:
The [batch-crop tutorial](https://www.befunky.com/learn/how-to-batch-crop-photos/) starts with Add Images or drag-and-drop, then Manage Tools → Crop. Choose an aspect ratio such as 1:1 or 16:9, set focal point/alignment and use Auto for subject placement. Crucially, crop targets can be moved individually; Reset Frames restores the selections. Apply only after inspecting the collection.

Save opens format, quality, filename and optional watermark settings, followed by Save Images and a download screen. The batch feature page lists PNG/JPG delivery. For a catalog, verify representative tall/wide subjects and fine text before applying to all images; preserve originals and check exported filenames/dimensions and transparency. The tutorial says no limit on image count, but no browser-memory, throughput or maximum-file benchmark was run, so that wording is not a capacity guarantee for an arbitrary machine.
sections.zh:
[批量裁切教程](https://www.befunky.com/learn/how-to-batch-crop-photos/)先用Add Images或拖放导入，再Manage Tools → Crop，选择如1:1或16:9比例，设置焦点/对齐，Auto可定位主体。关键是可逐图移动裁切框，Reset Frames可重置，应检查整组后再Apply。

Save中设置格式、质量、文件名和可选水印，再Save Images并从下载页取文件。批量功能页列PNG/JPG交付。商品目录应先检查高/宽主体和细小文字，保留原图，核对文件名、尺寸及透明度。教程虽称图片数无限，本文未跑浏览器内存、速度或大文件基准，因此不能视为任意机器容量保证。

sections.title_en: Annual totals and the Plus/Pro distinction
sections.en:
The normal browser showed USD Plus $6.99/month equivalent billed $83.88 annually and Pro $12.49 equivalent billed $149.88 annually. Selecting Monthly changed them to $14.99 and $24.99. These are the viewed plan offers; checkout taxes, renewal and regional variations were not tested. Free permits basic edits, limited assets and unsubscribed export; its card offers up to 20 AI images with a free account, without establishing an ongoing monthly quota.

Plus includes premium editing/design, Collage Wizard and basic bulk editing, with 1,000 monthly AI Image Generator credits. Pro adds AI Batch Editing and Batch Background Remover and provides 5,000 monthly credits shared between the generator and batch AI. “Full access” to tools is therefore different from unlimited credit-consuming use. Priority processing/support and model access are advertised, not measured here.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器显示美元Plus年付$83.88、折合每月$6.99，Pro年付$149.88、折合$12.49，切到Monthly后分别为$14.99和$24.99。这是本次方案报价，结账税费、续费及区域差异未测。Free可基础编辑、用有限素材并无订阅导出，卡片给免费账户最多20张AI图，但未证明是持续月额度。

Plus含高级编辑/设计、Collage Wizard及基础批量，每月1,000点仅列用于AI Image Generator；Pro增加AI批量和批量去背景，5,000月点由生成器及批量AI共享。“完整工具访问”与无限点数使用不同。优先处理/支持及模型访问属于宣传，本文未测量。

sections.title_en: Credits, rollover and cancellation have separate rules
sections.title_zh: 点数、结转及取消有独立规则
sections.en:
The [pricing FAQ](https://www.befunky.com/pricing/) says monthly plan credits do not roll over. Plus/Pro can buy top-ups; unused top-up credits roll over only while the subscription stays active. The read page does not establish a fixed per-generation/per-image rate or top-up price, so do not divide the allowance into a promised number of finished images. Confirm the cost shown for the actual model/operation before a batch.

Subscriptions renew monthly or annually unless canceled. Canceling retains premium access through the current billing cycle; the terms do not promise a refund once payment is processed. Plan/billing changes are managed in Account, with exact proration and top-up treatment to confirm. Keep exports and originals rather than assuming a canceled account remains an unlimited archive.
sections.zh:
[价格FAQ](https://www.befunky.com/pricing/)表示月度套餐点数不结转；Plus/Pro可买附加点，只有订阅仍有效时未用附加点才结转。实读页未给固定每次/每图消耗或附加点价格，不能把额度换算成保证的成图数量。批处理前应看实际模型/操作报价。

订阅按月/年自动续费，除非取消；取消后高级访问保留到当前账期末，条款不承诺已扣款退款。方案/账期在Account管理，具体比例计费及附加点处理需确认。应保留导出和原图，不能假定取消账户仍是无限档案库。

sections.title_en: Uploads, public images and AI output need different checks
sections.title_zh: 上传、公开图及AI输出分别检查
sections.en:
The [terms](https://www.befunky.com/terms/) retain users’ content rights and require permission to upload, modify and distribute it, while granting the service a content-use license. Images made public on BeFunky can be displayed elsewhere on its website under the stated public-image clause. Provider content/assets are not automatically cleared for unrestricted commercial redistribution. Its AI clause warns of inaccurate, biased or infringing output and places review responsibility on the user.

This is documentation research, not a clearance of a particular stock asset, font or generated design. Platform/software distribution rights, detailed private-photo retention/training and each asset’s commercial scope were not established; no open-source classification is inferred. No images were uploaded or edited, no batch/export was run and no purchase or quality comparison was performed.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://www.befunky.com/terms/)保留用户内容权利，要求用户有权上传、修改和分发，同时授予服务内容使用许可。在BeFunky设为公开的图片可按公开图条款在其网站其他位置展示，提供方素材不自动获准无限制商业再分发。AI条款警告输出可能不准确、有偏差或侵权，审查责任归用户。

本文是文档研究，不为具体图库、字体或生成设计清权。平台/软件分发权、私有照片详细保留/训练及各素材商业范围尚未建立，不推断开源分类。未上传/编辑图片、跑批量/导出、购买或比较质量。
